summary.text: Chris VanDijk is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 32 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Michelle Lee.
A firefighter and EMT, he advanced from the Democratic primary on June 30, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Chris VanDijk was born in Salt Lake City, Utah, and served in the U.S. Navy Reserve from 1991 to 1997.
He earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Utah in 1999 and a graduate degree from the University of Colorado Denver in 2024.
His career experience includes working as a firefighter and EMT, and he has been affiliated with the International Association of Fire Fighters and South Adams County Professional Fire Fighters.

In a Ballotpedia survey, VanDijk's profile described him as a firefighter for over a decade, a son of an immigrant, a former professional actor and a stay-at-home father who holds a master's degree in public policy.
The survey lists his three key messages as public safety and resiliency, affordable communities, and fair pay for fair work.
